import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 85

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="create_code",
    target="adapter.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Full implementation", "status": "overwritten"}
)

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="log_actions",
    target="tick_84",
    metadata={"eval_id": 199}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
